count_definitions.requests_started: score events begun by checkpoint; includes unfinished requests
count_definitions.requests_completed: score events finished on time by checkpoint; includes cache hits
count_definitions.deposition_result_evaluations: fresh completed events with physics_evaluated=true, meaning a deposition result was returned; not all solver entries or CPU/GPU invocations
count_definitions.geometry_rejections: fresh completed scores containing an explicit registered geometry error
count_definitions.eligible: joint geometry and physical eligibility; not geometry-only feasibility
count_definitions.coverage: actual completed active-level proposals with recorded vectors, returned deposition results, or jointly eligible scores; rejected random draws without recorded vectors cannot enter rank; unique vectors; centered affine rank scaled by fixed 0.2 m bounds
count_definitions.seed_ranges: descriptive within-equilibrium seed ranges, not confidence intervals
